reason: I'd use the free first visit on a Saturday, but $15 a kid every weekend adds up fast when the zoo is free. I wouldn't pay for it as a regular thing.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Up to 5 is a big gap from a crawler, and I'm only free weekends, when it's probably the busiest.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend session just for under-2s or a clear cap on numbers I can see on Saturdays, and a drop-in price closer to $10.
